description: Eco Smart pure last Measuring Spoons are durable, functional, colorful and easy on the environment. Made from natural materials of bamboo and rice fibers, they are BPA-free and food-safe and do not use any plastic binders or formaldehyde. These spoons are an important tool in every kitchen; with permanently marked measurements and curved handles, they are easy to use and comfortable to hold. The set of Measuring Spoons for baking and cooking, includes 1/4 T, 1/2 T, 1 T, 1/2 T, 1T. They nest together for easy storage and come with a removable metal ring which will help keep them together in your kitchen drawer. Easy to care for, they are dishwasher safe! Do not put in the microwave or use with colored gelatin.
